As a result, the LLM/inference pilot is being deprioritized for now and put into backlog. We don’t have a firm timeline — earliest realistic window would be late Q3.

We still want to keep the relationship and revisit once roadmap slots free up, but we need to pause scheduling any live technical walkthroughs for the foreseeable future.

I’ll keep you posted if anything changes sooner. Appreciate your flexibility.
